title: Migrate dependency management to package.json
body:
This change migrates the project's dependency management from Deno's `imports` in `deno.json` to a standard Node.js `package.json` file. It also cleans up unused dependencies and ensures a healthy development environment with proper TypeScript and ESLint configuration.
